instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a full shot from a side angle captures an indoor motion capture studio with a dark red carpeted floor and white walls. The man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left with his back partially to the camera, facing right. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing left and extending her left arm to touch the man's chest. Both individuals maintain neutral expressions. The scene is illuminated by even overhead indoor lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
